items.title: Joe Terranova Says “Inflation Lost” on Election Night. What That Means for Energy Stocks
items.summary: One CNBC trader says the fever has broken in energy and oil won't see $100 again. A rival panelist warns of a black swan that could flip the trade overnight, and income investors holding Exxon and Chevron have the most to lose.

items.title: Dow Rallies 1,590 Points on Midterm Relief: Stock Market Today
items.summary: Stocks of just about all sectors and sizes rose in the wake of a "blue wave" that resolved midterm election uncertainty. But AI and oil are still big variables.

items.title: Chevron Stocks Move Lower Refining Supplies Most of the Profit Increase
items.summary: Quarterly cash flow weakened sequentially despite a substantial annual earnings improvement.

items.title: How to Turn $250,000 Into Nearly $1,000 a Month in Passive Income
items.summary: Paychecks stop in retirement, but the bills never do. Five dividend payers spanning telecoms, tobacco, and oil can team up to cover a surprising amount of that gap every single month of the year.

items.title: BP Stock Gains 40.6% in a Year: Should You Bet on the Stock Now?
items.summary: BP stock has surged 40.6% in a year, driven by strong earnings. Portfolio restructuring, cost reductions and exploration investments strengthen its growth outlook.

items.title: WMB Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates Amid Higher Costs, Revenues Beat
items.summary: Williams' Q3 earnings miss estimates as costs jump 15%, even as revenues and EBITDA rise. Its $5.5B Momentum deal and new pipelines underpin expansion.

items.title: Physical Oil Just Went From a Bidding War to a Fire Sale
items.summary: Refiners who were fighting over every available barrel a month ago are now turning down offers and leaving Nigerian cargoes unsold, yet futures keep pricing in a war that the physical market seems to be moving past.

items.title: Bet on These Oil & Gas ETFs Capitalizing on the US-Iran War Windfall
items.summary: The US-Iran war has fueled record profits for American oil and gas giants. Discover four ETFs offering diversified exposure to this energy windfall.
